content:
Are you trying to save an email's attachments or to export the email itself?

Thunderbird for Android does NOT support saving email message to an .eml file.

If you want to backup the email body text, you can save each to a PDF file.

  1. Open the email
  2. Tap three button menu (top right) > print.
  3. Tap three button menu (top right) > save as pdf.

If you want to save the attachments

  1. Open the email
  2. Press "download complete message" if the button is displayed at the bottom of the email.
  3. Press the attachment "view all" button in the email header.
  4. Click the download icon next to each attachment

Note: There's is bug with the "save all" attachment button which causes each attachments to be saved as a duplicate of the first one. I'd recommend avoiding this button till fixed. Save each attachment individually.

On the email compose screen ...

  1. Tap the paperclip attachment icon in the toolbar.
  2. Select 'attach file'. A browsing window will open. Navigate and select your desired picture.
  3. Enter the email recipient address, subject and message body.
  4. Tap the triangular toolbar icon (right of the paperclip) to send the email.
